en.name: Alexander III
en.summary: A pope who endured a long schism and exile forced by Frederick Barbarossa, ultimately triumphing and presiding over the Third Lateran Council.
en.body: Alexander III's election was disputed by an imperially backed antipope, forcing him into exile in France for years while Frederick Barbarossa pursued repeated military campaigns in Italy. Lombard city alliances eventually defeated Barbarossa at the Battle of Legnano in 1176, forcing the emperor to make peace and recognize Alexander, who then convened the Third Lateran Council in 1179, establishing the two-thirds majority rule for papal elections by cardinals that endures in modified form today.
